persona: Mac user seeking polished defaults and easy actions

B01.reason: Remove repeated introductions while retaining the one consequence and current configuration state.

B02.reason: Context is the useful everyday adjustment; a visible Automatic or Custom batch summary preserves discoverability.

B03.reason: Two compact labelled ranges explain performance tradeoffs without requiring a second panel opening.

B04.reason: A clear Save action and explicit Apply review are easier to predict than six peer actions.

B05.reason: Experts need recommendations and applicability in the scan; general explanations can disclose.

B06.reason: One chosen priority and one recommendation minimize repeated cards while retaining deliberate access to all priorities.

B07.reason: Readable exact identity is necessary to recognize and confirm the file being selected.

B08.reason: Reading and answer speed describe different behavior; two small labelled values avoid an extra disclosure.

B09.reason: Compact no-fit recovery and shared-winner identification remove empty space and duplicated actions.

B10.reason: Existing usable models are the natural daily default; Discover remains one visible tab away.

B11.reason: Aligned facts make differences easier to compare than three nested narrative panels.

B12.reason: The explicit review and readiness gates survive, so optional adjustment does not need its own mandatory named step.

B13.reason: The plain labels express the choice directly; canonical names remain available for continuity.

B14.reason: The default route needs detected capacity, exact selection and commitment facts rather than mechanism explanations.

B15.reason: One truthful progress display and local recovery make preparation understandable.

B16.reason: Successful readiness should culminate in one clear Start chatting action.

B17.reason: Known shared-engine consequences and consistent request checks prevent surprising interruptions.

B18.reason: Scoped consolidation reduces repetition without turning estimates or mixed evidence into measurements.

B19.reason: One actual review-status line usefully qualifies a recommendation without reinstating generic tradeoff paragraphs.

B20.reason: Text-sample labels retain precision while reducing the implication of verified document-task support.

amendments: Use restrained normal metric sizing for B03/B08; retaining both rates does not require the current oversized hero numerals.
For B06 preserve a visible no-fit cue on an unavailable priority and identify shared winners; selecting a priority never loads a model.
For B12 label the compulsory commitment section Review setup, show exact custom state and actual download size, and expand invalid settings without overwriting them.
For B19 use only actual metadata; a missing review remains unknown or pending and never implies all ordinary tasks were tested.
Keep native integration limitations in accessible adapter details and simulated readiness explicitly labelled Demo.
